evidence_quote: benchmark the energy performance of the housing stock of Dutch housing associations
The social housing stock of 2.4 million dwellings

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Exclusive focus on the residential/social housing stock (dwellings) of Dutch non-profit housing associations, with no industrial component; falls under the Stage-1 'residential buildings without industrial component' exclusion.

paper_type.evidence_quote: which led to a final benchmark model

stage1.notes: Develops EnPI-style building-stock benchmark indicators (energy label kWh/m2/yr; kg CO2/m2/yr) for Dutch social-housing dwellings, but domain is residential with no industrial component -> ineligible. paper_type borderline: framework/model development that is also empirically applied to the Dutch sector (246 associations).
